title: sum_range off-by-one
description: sum_range(a, b) should return the sum of integers from a to b inclusive, but the final value is being dropped.

hidden_tests.test_calc.py:
from calc import sum_range


def test_inclusive():
    assert sum_range(1, 5) == 15
    assert sum_range(0, 0) == 0
    assert sum_range(3, 3) == 3
